q: A boat covers 30km downstream in 6hr, and the same distance upstream in 10hr. Find the boat's speed in still water.
Rohit covers 64km upstream in 8hr and 54km downstream in 3hr. Find the time for 41.99km in still water.
A raft travels at 12km/hr in still water; stream speed=4km/hr. Find the distance covered upstream in 15 minutes.
A boat covers 93km downstream in 4.5hr and 105km upstream in 6hr18min. Find the stream's speed.
A motorboat's speed:stream's speed=55:7. It goes downstream in 6hr24min. Find the return (upstream) time.
A boat travels one point to another downstream in 19hr, and the same distance upstream in 23hr. Stream speed=2km/hr. Find the distance.
A small plane flies at 320km/hr in still air; wind=40km/hr. Against the wind takes 135min total. Find the return time with the wind.
A motorboat's still-water speed=10km/hr. It travels 36km downstream and returns, total 20hr. Find the stream's speed.
A boat's still-water speed is 4× the stream's speed. A round trip covers a total of 270km in 7.2hr. Find the boat's speed.
sol: One-way=135km. Solving with stream=s,boat=4s gives s=10, boat=40km/hr

q: A boat covers 36km upstream in 3hr and the same distance downstream in 1.8hr. Find the still-water speed.
A man swims in still water at 14km/hr; stream=6km/hr. The same distance takes 7.5hr more upstream than downstream. Find the distance.
A boat's still-water speed=25km/hr, stream=7km/hr. A round trip A to B and back takes 6hr40min. Find the time for double the AB distance downstream only.
sol: Solving gives one-way d=76.8km. Time for 2d downstream=4h48m

q: A boat travels A to B against the current and B to A with it, total 5hr. Boat speed=10km/hr, stream=5km/hr. Find distance AB.
A round-trip river journey of 35km each way takes 10hr30min total. The time to cover 5km downstream equals the time for 4km upstream. Find the stream's rate.
sol: b=9s from the equal-time condition. Solving the total-time equation gives s=0.75km/hr

q: A motorboat's still-water speed=45km/hr. It covers 80km downstream in 1hr20min. Find the time for the same distance upstream.
A person covers 39km upstream+116km downstream in 7hr, and 65km upstream+87km downstream in 8hr. Find the still-water speed.
A boat's speed is 1.75× the stream's speed. Downstream 132km+upstream 60km takes 8hr total. Find how much slower the upstream speed is vs. downstream.
The upstream time for a fixed distance is 60% more than the downstream time. Stream speed=9km/hr. Find the time for 504km downstream.
A boat's downstream speed=10km/hr, upstream=8km/hr. Find the time for 36km in still water.
A round trip (down then up) takes 4hr54min. Boat speed=31.85km/hr, stream=13.65km/hr. Find the one-way distance.
Two boats start simultaneously toward each other from points 174km apart on a river — one upstream, one downstream. Still-water speeds=9.6,19.4km/hr. Find the meeting time.
sol: Stream effect cancels in closing speed: 9.6+19.4=29. Time=174/29=6hr
